subject: Indian artisan sustainable recycled-metal, mango-wood, and textile homeware for Shared Earth UK Ltd
body_text:
Hello Shared Earth UK Ltd team,

I noticed Recycled brass elephant wind chime handmade in India, Asha Handicrafts Indian homeware range in your public catalogue. Your long-running Asha Handicrafts relationship and current Indian recycled-metal and homeware assortment show a clear category fit, even though they do not prove an open supplier requirement.

We may be able to assemble a tightly curated India-sourced selection in sustainable recycled-metal, mango-wood, and textile homeware, backed by a verified producer shortlist. Materials, production capacity, MOQ, documentation, and lead-time evidence would be clearly separated from assumptions. Would you be open to reviewing a small, relevant selection? If so, could you point me to the person responsible for sourcing or buying this category?

No price, delivery date, payment term, certification, origin, or product availability is being committed in this introduction. Those details would be verified before any quotation.

If this is not relevant, please let me know and I will not follow up.

Regards,
Raghav
